answer: A bond must be split across 5 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Because each voyage escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the basalt ledger records every share and the dune audit reveals the split. Assembling that for 28 aliases means 28 times 5 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. That is 33 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
